scripts.prepare:frontend: pnpm --filter @foggy/chat-core run build && pnpm --filter @foggy/chat run build
scripts.typecheck:frontend: pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm --filter @foggy/navigator-frontend run type-check && pnpm --filter @foggy/mobile run type-check
scripts.build:frontend: pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm --filter @foggy/navigator-chat-widget run build && pnpm --filter @foggy/navigator-frontend run build:check && pnpm --filter @foggy/mobile run build:h5
scripts.ci:frontend: pnpm run typecheck:frontend && pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run build:frontend
